user_intent: Figure out why the Vercel production deployment stopped working.
resolution: Diagnosed that production was stuck on an old successful deploy: comparing prod asset hashes with the local build showed staleness, and the GitHub deployments API (queried via a python urllib script since Vercel CLI was not logged in) showed the last 4 production deploys failed. Root cause: @astrojs/check was added to package.json without a lockfile update and peers on TypeScript ^5||^6 while the project uses TS 7, so Vercel's npm ci hits ERESOLVE before the build. Fix: removed @astrojs/check, pointed the typecheck script at tsc --noEmit, and verified with a clean npm ci + full verify locally.
